> Postgres bytea parser


***REMOVED******REMOVED*** Install

```
$ npm install --save postgres-bytea
```


***REMOVED******REMOVED*** Usage

```js
var bytea = require('postgres-bytea');
bytea('\\000\\100\\200')
//=> buffer
```

***REMOVED******REMOVED*** API

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** `bytea(input)` -> `buffer`

***REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED******REMOVED*** input

*Required*  
Type: `string`

A Postgres bytea binary string.
